meta.name: computer-use
meta.description: Drives the GUI of a visible local app window through `orca computer`: accessibility tree, clicks, typing, menus, dialogs, and screenshots in native apps and external browser windows (Chrome, Edge, Safari) or webviews. Prefer a programmatic path (shell, filesystem, git, HTTP, existing CLIs) whenever it can complete the task. Use only when a visible window needs GUI control those cannot reach. Do not use for Orca's embedded browser (`orca-cli`).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让程序替你操作桌面窗口,自动点击、输入、读菜单并截图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果某个软件只有界面没有接口,却还要一遍遍手动操作它。
copy.tagline_en: Drive a desktop window for you: click, type, read menus, and capture screenshots
copy.fit_line_en: For you if an app only offers a UI and you keep operating it by hand.

howto.what: Claude 会用 `orca computer` 操作本地可见窗口:读取无障碍树、点击、输入、菜单和截图,覆盖原生应用及 Chrome、Edge、Safari 等外部浏览器。能用命令行、文件、HTTP 等程序化方式完成时,不走这条 GUI 路径。
howto.when: 当可见窗口需要 GUI 控制、而命令行或 HTTP 等程序化路径无法完成时才接管;不适用于 Orca 内置浏览器(orca-cli)。

say.text: 用 orca computer 在当前窗口点一下保存按钮
say.note: 先加载版本匹配的指南再执行

say.text: 截一张当前 Chrome 窗口的图
say.note: 通过 orca computer 获取截图

say.text: 在这个应用的菜单里选「导出」

howto.what_en: Claude drives a visible local window via `orca computer`: accessibility tree, clicks, menus and screenshots, in native apps and external browsers like Chrome, Edge, Safari. It prefers programmatic paths (shell, files, HTTP) when they can finish the task.
howto.when_en: Only when a visible window needs GUI control that shell, files or HTTP cannot reach; not for Orca's embedded browser (orca-cli).

say_en.text: Use orca computer to click the Save button in this window
Take a screenshot of the current Chrome window
